mentions.name: Calculus the Game
mentions.description: An electronic board game compatible with Settlers of Catan, built around custom PCB boards, electronics, and firmware, with plenty of LEDs. The boards, electronics, and firmware are in good working order, with plans for original rulesets, artwork, and manuals. It is a non-commercial open project, with files provided so anyone can build their own copy.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made an electronic board game: https://github.com/seanboyce/Calculus-the-game

It's compatible with Settlers of Catan. However, I plan to make my own rulesets, artwork, manuals, etc. It will not be a commercial product, of course you can make your own with the files I provide.
